text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion and I head into our second summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can do this! Raaagh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But of course! After all…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This is the year I shall realize my goal of trying every kind of ramen at the beach house!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Surely you understand that eating nothing but ramen is unacceptable from a nutritional standpoint.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's why I couldn't complete my ramen conquest last year. Not only that, we have a race in the middle of this summer camp, correct?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That makes the road to ramen conquest harsher yet. However, I have a secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I call it… the "Can I have a bite?" approach! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's one of the many things I've learned at the academy! If everyone shares their food, then I'll be able to try every variety on offer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And that is why I would like to request your cooperation. ♪
choice_data_list: If you work hard at training, I'll consider it.
If you work hard at training, I'll consider it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Certainly! That goes without saying! Oh…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're not wavering anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're playing your role exactly as written.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right. Apologies, but I can't become a god.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I will, however, perform my role with aplomb. I'll run in such a way as to set your heart dancing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If I can do that… maybe I can at least become an angel.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Are you stupid or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Who needs gods or angels? If you won't do it…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll just have to take care of it myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, the reason Air Shakur is so fixated on Fine Motion remains unclear. However…
choice_data_list: It looks like she's made up her mind.
It looks like she's made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sure she'll face any obstacle head-on and power through.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I, too, must work hard and become stronger!
